chunks: Mūsā ibn Bakr narrated from Zurārah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
A woman divorced three times has no right to maintenance or lodging from her husband. That applies only to the woman whose husband still has the right to take her back.

key_terms.ثَلَاثًا: three times; indicating a completed triple divorce
key_terms.رَجْعَةٌ: the husband's right to take back his wife in a revocable divorce
key_terms.نَفَقَةٌ: financial maintenance owed for living expenses

ai.seo_question: Does a woman divorced three times receive maintenance and housing during her waiting period?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the financial and housing rights of a divorced woman. It states that a woman divorced three times is not entitled to maintenance or accommodation, and that such support applies only in a revocable divorce where the husband retains the right of rajʿah.
